title: InstanceConfig
description: Per-deployment configuration for a BulletinMail instance. See PRD §20.

apexDomain.description: Root domain serving the instance, e.g. 'lists.example.org'.

unsubscribeAddressPrefix.description: Local-part prefix for one-click unsubscribe tokens, e.g. 'unsubscribe+'.

mailSubdomain.description: Optional DNS label to host outbound + inbound mail on. When set, system addresses (noreply, support, abuse, dmarc) and the unsubscribe mailto live at <mailSubdomain>.<apex> instead of <apex>. In single-tenant deployments this is the recommended pattern (default 'mail') — the apex serves the wiki/admin web UI, and mail lives on its own subdomain with its own SPF/DKIM/DMARC. The lone tenant's slug equals mailSubdomain in single-tenant mode, so list addresses become <group>@<mailSubdomain>.<apex>. In multi-tenant mode this only affects system addresses; list addresses still use <group>@<tenant>.<apex>.

ai.description: Workers AI tuning for the features.ai.* flags. Only consulted when at least one flag is on and the web Worker has the AI binding.

dailyGenerationCap.description: Max AI generation calls (text or image) per tenant per UTC day. Counted in D1 (ai_usage table); once hit, generation refuses with a clear 'limit reached' message until the next UTC day.

textModel.description: Workers AI text-generation model id used by promote-to-wiki and red-link autogen. Configurable so operators can track Workers AI model deprecations without a source change.

imageModel.description: Workers AI text-to-image model id used for wiki hero images.

singleTenant.description: When true, the apex domain IS the tenant (no <slug>.<apex> subdomains). The wiki, /admin/, /join/, /auth/ all serve from the apex root. The single tenant is identified by the fixed slug 'main'. First admin signup atomically creates the tenant row + admin. The marketing landing page and Astro docs are skipped. Set this in the deployments/<apex>/instance.config.json overlay for single-org deployments.

searchEnabled.description: Unified search over the mail archive + wiki via Cloudflare Vectorize + Workers AI embeddings. When true, render-wrangler keeps the Vectorize binding blocks in the web + inbound Workers (the operator must first create the index: wrangler vectorize create bulletinmail-search --dimensions=768 --metric=cosine, plus a tenant_id string metadata index). When false (default) the binding blocks are stripped, the /search UI hides, and all indexing hooks no-op. The weekly digest works either way — it has no AI/Vectorize dependency.

ai.description: LLM extras, each independently opt-in and default OFF. These are the only features that can meaningfully consume paid resources, so they ship dark. A flag alone is not enough — the web Worker must also have the Workers AI binding; when absent the features hide entirely. Zero Workers AI calls when off. See docs/how-to/ai-features.md for enabling and honest cost notes.

promoteToWiki.description: Admins/moderators can promote an archive thread into an LLM-drafted wiki page. The draft opens in the editor for human review — never auto-published.

wikiAutogen.description: Following a red link to a missing wiki page offers signed-in editors a 'Generate draft with AI' action that writes a first draft in the wiki's voice, seeding [[links]] to existing pages.

wikiHeroImages.description: AI-generated hero images for wiki pages, stored in the wiki R2 bucket and served from /wiki/img/.
